problem: Multimodal language understanding models for instruction-following robots (e.g., VLN/ALFRED) lack robustness, and evaluating domestic service robots requires manual task generation, execution and scoring. The extracted text is only a Japanese KAKEN grant final report, with most body text and figures lost.
motivation: Robust multimodal language understanding via adversarial data augmentation, together with language generation and Sim2Real evaluation, is needed for practical assistive/domestic robots. The report describes a project with understanding, generation and Sim2Real sub-teams.
key_idea: Build Momentum-based Adversarial Training (MAT), an adversarial perturbation update algorithm, for robust Vision-and-Language Navigation/ALFRED, plus future-captioning and an automated Sim2Real evaluation framework.
insight: Only the abstract-level content is available; the extracted text has no ablations or numbers for MAT. Reported claims are that MAT gave successful results on ALFRED, RSA-based future captioning beat existing methods, and on-the-fly instruction generation automates robot evaluation.
method: Momentum-based Adversarial Training (MAT): adversarial perturbation update algorithm applied to VLN, evaluated on ALFRED
Future captioning (RFCM): generates sentences describing future situations from video, uses Relational Self-Attention (RSA) in a MART-based captioner with a CLIP-based loss
Target-dependent UNITER: transformer-based multimodal language comprehension model for domestic service robot fetching instructions (prior work)

Fetch-and-Carry with Object Grounding (FCOG) Sim2Real evaluation framework in Unity: on-the-fly instruction generation and automated task execution (Navigation, Object Location Retrieval, Fetching, Carrying) with MPFE

setting.backbone: UNITER-based transformers, MART with RSA, CLIP (details unclear from extracted text)
setting.training_data: not stated in extracted text (ALFRED for MAT; PFN-PIC and WRS-UniALT for comprehension; future captioning dataset)
setting.observation: not stated (RGB images plus language instructions)
setting.action_space: not stated for MAT; FCOG has navigation, fetching and carrying subtasks

numbers_note: Text is a grant report with figures and tables largely lost in extraction; MAT numbers on ALFRED are not present. Only non-navigation numbers appear (e.g., 96.9%/90.1%/96.4%/91.8% comprehension accuracies, CIDEr-D 60.37 vs 49.61), not attributable as navigation results.
results: The abstract states MAT achieved successful results on ALFRED and the future captioning method outperformed existing methods on standard metrics. No quantitative navigation results are recoverable from the text.
